description: This header file defines templates and classes for portable calculation of type alignment, including aligned character arrays and unions for storage of multiple types, with special handling for MSVC compiler differences.

classes.name: AlignedCharArray
classes.description: Template for creating an aligned character array with specified alignment and size, with specializations for MSVC compiler.

classes.name: AlignedCharArrayUnion
classes.description: Template for creating a union of aligned character arrays capable of holding multiple types.

methods.name: AlignedCharArray
methods.description: Template struct for creating an aligned character array, with specializations for different alignments.

methods.name: AlignedCharArrayUnion
methods.description: Template struct for creating a union of aligned character arrays for multiple types.
